bio: Part of the region near La Coruña known as the Coast of Death, Fisterra has reinvigorated its culinary options thanks to this restaurant occupying a former bar overlooking Da Ribeira beach. Having trained in award-winning restaurants such as Casa Marcial (La Salgar, in the Asturias region) and Mina (Bilbao), young chef Brais Pichel has returned home to take his turn at the helm of the family business, transforming it into a contemporary space with a highly consistent culinary approach in the kitchen. Just a single tasting menu is on offer here, one which is modern in approach, changes almost daily, and showcases the labours of local producers, with fish featuring prominently.
